description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with external services like OpenAI and a vector store for document retrieval, enabling question-answering based on textbook chapters.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing a local vector store used for document retrieval in the RAG process.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs a retrieval-augmented generation process: embedding the question, searching relevant document chunks, and generating a detailed answer with citations.
